body.x: Huria(representative Eui-bong Park, www.huria.co.kr) will show Headphone/ Headset/ Earset of bone conduction at CES 2012 held from Jan 10-13.

People who has conduction deafness can perceive sound with Bone Conduction Headphone, and people who has healthy ear can enjoy the music while hearing surrounding sound. Bone Conduction Headphone deliver sound to nerve through Bone not through eardrum.

Wireless Bone Conduction Headset ‘EARBONE(HUB-401) has embedded Mike and it has Bluetooth function to be compatible with all kinds of electronic equipment, also it improved weakness of low output, with amplifier function.

Bone Conduction Earset 'Saybone' combined Bone conduction mike and normal earphone, this product deliver only user's voice who insert Bone conduction mike inside ear. So, it can be used usefully and variously when user in noisy environment, industrial settings and user drives a car and enjoys leisure activities.
Above this, Huria will exhibit Bone conduction Sound Collector, Bone conduction Handsfree Headset and Bone conduction Headphone
Meanwhile, Huria is exhibiting in Hilton Hall Booth No.46011, Convention Center, Las Vegas, US.
